description:
This is a SMW stylized Yoshi small and big for those whole think YI style clashes with their style of hack.

Please delete the existing "Yoshi SMW Style" by me.Thanks and enjoy ;)

Finally,Thanks to SonicBlue77 request for an SMW small Yoshi.
